Thought: The structure has been successfully converted to a LAMMPS data file. Now, I need to prepare the LAMMPS input script for the quenching and relaxation processes using the specified parameters. I will then run the simulation.
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/quenching/brief/tasks/magnesium_quenching_trial_1/lammps_input.in", "content": "units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/quenching/brief/tasks/magnesium_quenching_trial_1/magnesium_structure.data
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg.eam.alloy Mg
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol

# NPT Quench
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT Relaxation
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Output final density
variable density equal mass(all)/vol
print 'Final density: ${density} g/cm^3'
"}
